name: AWS first-seen: secretsmanager-get-secret-value (behavioral)
description: Behavioral detection. Fires when (userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.secretId) is new for this principal in the last 90 days. Source rule: rules/credential-access/secretsmanager-get-secret-value.yml. Adjust field names to your Elastic CloudTrail mapping (e.g. aws.cloudtrail.* with the Fleet integration).
